editorial.name: Tandym
editorial.descriptionZh: Tandym 给零售品牌做自有品牌支付卡：绕开卡组织通道把手续费压到 1% 以下，省下的钱变成给顾客的积分和复购。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看支付产品怎么把费率写成三段收益账
editorial.noteZh: 墨绿底首屏，左侧衬线大字 The best place for your brand is your customer's wallet，副题写 Tandym puts it there. Our branded payments suite reduces processing fees to less than 1%. Use those savings to give shoppers better rewards and improve retention metrics.，白色 See a Demo 与描边 Explore Solutions 并排。右侧一张堆叠卡片样机：最上面是件裙子的商品卡，角标写着 unique vintage，中间一条杏色横带写 uv Pay 与 Earn 5% in store points，下面依次是 Credit Card、PayPal、Apple Pay 三个选项；底边压着一条深色横条 See how Tandym seamlessly integrates with your existing customer experience。正文 Branded payments create value in 3 ways 摆出三格账：<1% Reduce processing fees、+25% Increase in lifetime value、$$$ Unlock revenue share，再分 Shopping Experience 与 Checkout Experience 两段讲前端怎么呈现。
editorial.pricing: unknown（页面只讲费用优势，未给产品档位）

reasons.statement: 这是 Tandym 自家的支付产品官网，从 saaslandingpage.com 收进候选池；页面只有 See a Demo 与 Sign In，交付的是给品牌接入的自有支付方案，归产品与公司官网。
拿不准：Merchants / Shoppers / Our Brands 三栏把商户端与持卡人端分开，读作支付工具也成立；但没有任何可直接拿走的设计或代码产物。
